scope: Purple seed tiers 1-4, their type-6 plant output, berry-grant contact objects, equip-byte writes, and row-specific lifecycle/reset behavior

capsule.evidence_boundary: Frame-boundary RAM and passive block coverage only; exact instructions and branches come from the pristine executable.

producer.one_shot: After allocation, 0x8005C738..0x8005C740 ORs 0x0008 into slot+0x2E. The admission mask then fails, preventing a second grant from that plant instance.

contact_lifecycle.uncollected_expiry: Shared contact countdown starts at 230 logic ticks, approximately 7.67 seconds at 30 Hz.
contact_lifecycle.collection: The walker dispatch overwrites 0x800A6597, sets the record to common state 7 and count 1, and invokes the common pickup bookkeeping.
contact_lifecycle.retirement_control: For the tier-1 record, equip changes at frame 133396, the collected record remains at count 1 through frame 133397, and it is inactive by frame 133398.

equip_and_reset.overwrite: Each grant directly overwrites the current equip value; no stack, inventory, or same-tier denial exists in the four handlers.
equip_and_reset.throw: 0x80047160..0x8004725C reads equip for dispatch but contains no equip write. Accepted throws do not consume or reset the selected berry type.
equip_and_reset.level_load: 0x80046B68 calls the bulk clear with player base 0x800A6500 and length 0xA8, covering 0x800A6597 and restoring red/default equip 0.
equip_and_reset.other_native_writers: The direct pristine frontier also contains a separate assignment family at 0x8005428C..0x800542DC and the contact-walker assignments at 0x80058934..0x80058980. B10 claims only its four walker actions.
